# Golos

> Free, open-source, fully offline Russian voice dictation for Linux/X11. Hold a key,
> speak, release, then paste punctuated text from the clipboard. Recognition uses
> GigaAM v3 locally; no GPU, account, cloud service or subscription is required.

Golos supports Russian only and currently requires Linux with X11. Internet access is
used by a separate downloader only for the one-time model download. Audio and
recognized text are not written to disk. Version 0.1.0, MIT license.

## Primary documentation

- [English website](https://geft1310-hue.github.io/golos/en/): Canonical English product page with installation, measurements, comparisons, privacy claims, limitations and source links.
- [Russian website](https://geft1310-hue.github.io/golos/): Canonical Russian product page.
- [English Markdown overview](https://geft1310-hue.github.io/golos/overview.en.md): Clean, citation-oriented project summary without page chrome.
- [Russian Markdown overview](https://geft1310-hue.github.io/golos/overview.ru.md): Чистая русская справка для цитирования.
- [Extended context](https://geft1310-hue.github.io/golos/llms-full.txt): Consolidated verified facts, limitations, installation steps and source hierarchy.

## Source and verification

- [Source repository](https://github.com/geft1310-hue/golos): Application code, README files and issue tracker.
- [Release 0.1.0](https://github.com/geft1310-hue/golos/releases/tag/v0.1.0): First public release.
- [Bench and privacy checks](https://github.com/geft1310-hue/golos/tree/main/bench): Reproducible speed, memory, hotkey, audio and privacy checks.
- [Security-sensitive hotkey implementation](https://github.com/geft1310-hue/golos/blob/main/golos/hotkey.py): Narrow XGrabKey use for a single keycode.
- [Separate model downloader](https://github.com/geft1310-hue/golos/blob/main/tools/fetch_models.py): The only project component designed to open a network connection.

## Upstream projects and measurements

- [GigaAM v3](https://github.com/salute-developers/GigaAM): Russian speech-recognition model by SberDevices, MIT license.
- [GigaAM evaluation](https://github.com/salute-developers/GigaAM/blob/main/evaluation.md): Vendor accuracy and punctuation measurements.
- [onnx-asr](https://github.com/istupakov/onnx-asr): ONNX inference wrapper used by Golos, MIT license.
- [Independent Russian ASR benchmark](https://habr.com/ru/articles/1042574/): Third-party CPU speed and WER comparison cited by the project.
